plugins.name: zeroh-mask
plugins.description: Client-side PII detection for Claude Code prompts. Blocks sensitive prompts and presents a deterministically tokenized rewrite to paste back; builds signed SD-JWT receipts and (optionally) anchors them to Hedera HCS at turn end.
